body:
Follow-up to garment-twonodeheld, taking the first item of its next steps. Retunes the skin-temperature gate band for actuation lags of 0, 2, 5 and 10 min and switch penalties of 0, 0.01 and 0.03 C, then scores on held-out rooms. Findings: lag cuts the gate's gain over never switching from 0.234 to 0.150 C; a penalty widens the band and mostly removes chatter; under the reference choice set the tuned band loses to the untuned one in 3 of 24 cells and once to never switching. Stylised, preliminary, assumed lags and penalties.

Checks: 5 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok (404 projects); README bullet and projects.json entry added; every README number checked against experiments/results.txt. No new citations. Run line appended to prompts/runs.jsonl.
